title: Planet Selection
description: The ways a player picks a planet: for a card effect, for a structure, a planet or technology, a planet outcome in a vote, and planets to exhaust when paying (now on the map, with a confirm bar).

shots.heading: A card asks for a planet
shots.caption: Mining Initiative: candidate planets are ringed on the map and the bar names the card and what will happen. Planets that cannot be chosen are dimmed.

shots.heading: After choosing on the map
shots.caption: Clicking Lodor on the map selects it. The bar now reads "Mining Initiative — mine Lodor (3R/1I)" with Confirm and Cancel; the other candidates stay available as chips.

shots.heading: Planet first, then the structure
shots.caption: When several options share a planet, picking the planet turns the bar into one button per structure: place a PDS or a space dock on Jord.

shots.heading: A planet or a technology
shots.caption: Bio-Stims can ready a planet on the map or an exhausted technology. Technologies appear as chips in the same bar.

shots.heading: Voting for a planet
shots.caption: An Elect Planet agenda has planets as outcomes, so the vote is cast by choosing a planet on the map.

shots.heading: Paying: the list
shots.caption: The payment list shows each ready planet with what it is worth against what is owed (5 resources), with Auto-pay and Pick on map next to Pay. It also says why Pay is still disabled ("Short by 5 resources").

shots.heading: Paying: payable planets on the map
shots.caption: Pick on map closes the list and shows the payment bar. Every planet you can exhaust is ringed and labelled with its value (4R, 3R, 1R); everything else is dimmed. The bar shows nothing paid yet.

shots.heading: Paying: partially paid from the map
shots.caption: Clicking Jord on the map stages it: green ring and tick, and the bar reads Paid 4 / 5 resources, 1 remaining. Pay stays disabled with the reason; clicking Jord again takes it back. The system inspector no longer opens on these clicks.

shots.heading: Paying: Auto-pay
shots.caption: Auto-pay stages the planets that cover the bill with the least waste (Jord 4 + Quann 1 = 5, not the biggest planets) and uses trade goods only when planets fall short. It only stages: the bar says Covered and Pay (5 staged) is enabled, nothing is paid until you press it.

shots.heading: Paying: the map and the list agree
shots.caption: Open decision list shows the same selection: Jord, picked on the map, is ticked and 4 of 5 resources are staged. Ticking in the list updates the map the same way.

notes.title: Map clicks
notes.text: While paying, a click on a payable planet token stages or unstages it; the hex only inspects. In the other planet selections a click still picks the planet.

notes.title: Still separate
notes.text: Influence for votes (the agenda ballot) keeps its own planet list; it is highlighted on the map but has no confirm bar yet.

notes.title: Submission
notes.text: Pay sends the same batch plan as before (planet exhausts, then trade goods), from the bar or the list.
